task.title: To make an inserted field smart or read-only

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce) and open the template.
In the Templates pane, go to Work> Fields. This displays the Repeat Table (object name) and the fields in the repeat table.
Enter the field name in the Search Field and click the search icon ().
Click theSettings button next to the selected field name to open the Properties page.
In the attributes list, toggle the Smart Field or Read-Only Field switches based on your requirement and click Save.
